subject: Re: Velox dedicated fleet - staggered top-up and sizing sync
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@velox.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@velox.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Velox dedicated fleet: staggered top-up request and utilization summary

Hi Rachel / Laura,

Thanks again for the QBR last week — the usage visibility you shared was super helpful. We ran the numbers on our side and need to request a temporary, staggered top-up to our Dedicated pool for Q3. Quick summary:

- Current committed GPUs: 120 (steady-state)
- Observed 90th-percentile utilization (May): 78% across inference workloads
- Expected peak windows: Aug–Sep (model A ensemble serving) with 6–8 hour daily spikes
- Request: add 40 GPUs in two tranches (20 on Jul 15, +20 on Aug 15) through Oct 31, with ability to convert into committed capacity early if needed.

I've attached a small export of our hourly utilization (velox_usage_Mar-May-2027.csv) to help sizing. Our procurement team (cc'd) will need indicative pricing and whether a partial commit discount applies to tranche conversions.

Can you confirm feasibility and the lead times for provisioning the first tranche? If a phone sync helps, happy to book a 30-min slot.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Platform
Velox AI

Attachments: velox_usage_Mar-May-2027.csv (CSV, 1.2MB)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@velox.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@velox.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Velox dedicated fleet: staggered top-up request and utilization summary

Samir — thanks for the data and clear ask. We're confident we can support a staggered top-up, but there are a few knobs to align on:

1) Tranche lead time: standard provisioning is ~10 business days for Dedicated tranches; for Jul 15 we'd need a signed addendum by Jul 1.
2) Sizing verification: 40 GPUs split 20/20 looks reasonable given the utilization spike shape, but our infra team wants a short run of 1-week simulated traffic to validate autoscaling behavior on the Dedicated pool before the second tranche.
3) Pricing: we can offer a conversion credit if you commit to converting both tranches into a 3-month committed add-on within 30 days of the second tranche provisioning. Ben can provide numbers.

Proposed next steps (quick):
- Ben: draft tranche amendment + provisional pricing (by Thu)
- Laura: confirm provisioning SLA and validation window (by Wed)
- Samir / procurement: confirm sign-off timeline and whether you want the conversion credit option (by Fri)

If that works, I'll book a 30-min call Wed to walk through the amendment.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Velox dedicated fleet: staggered top-up request and utilization summary

Samir — saw the attachment and ran a quick capacity model. A couple of notes:

- Baseline headroom: with 120 committed and current utilization, adding 20 GPUs should cover the median daily spike but may clip very heavy ensemble windows. The second 20 (Aug) is the right safety buffer.
- Autoscaling behavior: recommend enabling a 2-min scale-in cooldown during high-frequency traffic and a continuous-batching friendly kernel set for Model A to reduce per-token cost at peak.
- Costing outline: attached a draft tranche amendment (proposed_tranche_schema_v2.pdf) with two options:
  A) Temporary add-on (no commit): higher per-GPU rate, cancellable at period end.
  B) Commit-conversion: lower effective rate if both tranches converted to a 3-month commitment within 30 days after second tranche.

Action items from Redwood:
- Draft legal addendum + pricing (attached).
- Run a one-week validation in our staging cluster (copy of your config) prior to Aug tranche.

If Velox confirms Jul 15 for tranche 1, we can prioritize provisioning and reserve a warm rack. Lead time still ~10 business days.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_tranche_schema_v2.pdf (PDF, 320KB)

Samir / Rachel — quick note from a commercial perspective. We want to make the conversion path simple and predictable for procurement. Two proposals:

1) Conversion credit: if both tranches are converted to a 3-month commit by Nov 30, Velox receives a credit equal to 25% of the tranche fees back-applied to committed spend.
2) Early-conversion discount: alternatively, convert the first tranche within 14 days and get a 10% protected discount on tranche 2 pricing.

Also want to confirm billing alignment: do you prefer a single consolidated invoice for the entire add-on period (Jul–Oct) or per-tranche invoices? We can do either, but procurement should indicate preference for internal AP routing.

If procurement confirms consolidated billing and agreement to a conversion window, legal can fast-track the addendum.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Operations 
Redwood Inference
